The "Harry Wright Shield" Competition ended as follows :— Points were scored for this Shield in the High Jump, Long Jump, Javelin and Shot Putt events, and George Powell, our Field Events Captain, succeeded in winning the Shield for the first time, closely followed, however, by B.
The first move to this end has been the alteration of conditions for competition for the shield mentioned above, presented by our loyal supporter, Mr.
Thomas and H. Wright; and then quickly surveyed the past year's performances.
Leaders in the "Harry Wright" Shield Competition for Club athletes are B.
We have not yet instituted Championships for these events although the "Harry Wright" Shield is awarded annually to the best performer in this section.
